additional_info.subject: RE: ID0428233-DC/Si-D/AE- [MP/R8 170002520] Not Stopping Session CRM:02832000038
additional_info.body:
Hello,
We are currently investifating this issue together with the R&D. I could offer to update the charger in the meanwhile.The issue is related to the EcoG controller not able to process the Remote stop transaction, we donnot know yet if it's coming from a wrong OCPP certificate or an bug. The new version include an update of the EcoG controller (SECC). Would like to update to 7.0.1 ?
Also is this issue happen only on outlet 2 or also on outlet 1 ? Is it only via Remote stop transaction ?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL
Please d
o not change the subject of this email when replying to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0428233-DC/Si-D/AE- [MP/R8 170002520] Not Stopping Session CRM:02832000038
additional_info.body:
Hi Francois,
Yes, Please proceed with the update. Aslo to your query, we have observed both the outlet having the same issue. And we have noticed only Remote stop transactions is not working from ocpp comments.
